rationale: The file contains recognizable HLF transaction entrypoints (Init and Invoke methods). However, no C1–C6 vulnerability patterns exist. The code uses time.Unix() to format historical timestamps for display (L558), which reads from the ledger's immutable history and does not influence any write decision. All queries (GetStateByRange, GetQueryResult, GetHistoryForKey) are either read-only returns via shim.Success or used only to construct deterministic response buffers without conditional write logic. No goroutines, map iterations, global mutable state, or time.Now() calls that influence writes are present.
